package.description: Batch print utility for HTML files and web sites. Print Multiple Web Pages will help you save time when printing a large number of HTML documents or online web pages.

en-US.description: Batch print utility for HTML files and web sites. Print Multiple Web Pages will help you save time when printing a large number of HTML documents or online web pages.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Print Multiple Web Pages is a batch print utility for HTML files and websites. This web page printing software will help you save time when printing a large number of HTML documents or online web pages in bulk.

You can add many HTML documents or webpage links to the list and preview them in the dedicated area. After you click the "Print All" button, the application will send them all into the printing queue of your default printer.

The application internally uses Internet Explorer engine for preview and printing. You can use the "Browser" menu for displaying web pages using different versions of the browser. You can also use the "Delay after page load" option for better results in case a web page runs time-consuming scripts.

Another useful feature of the program is that it can extract and list all URLs in the entered text. Click "Add URL List" button then make sure you checked "Auto-detect URLs in text" box. The software will list all the addresses in the text one by one for you.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Print Multiple Web Pages
